Q2 2026 Action Plan

Prioritized recommendations based on Q1 data
Ordered by urgency and potential platform impact
Critical
Investigate the March offer-acceptance collapse immediately
Accepted offers fell 71% (234 → 67) while applications hit Q1 peak (90,325). Conduct structured interviews with Alinma, ARO Drilling, and Takamol to diagnose root causes.
Owner: Client Success Lead · First 2 weeks of Q2
Critical
Re-engage 2 zero-activity clients before contract renewal
NCM and WEQAA had zero Q1 platform usage. Assign a named CSM to each, prepare personalized re-onboarding plans, and schedule calls within 10 business days.
Owner: Account Management · This week
Critical
Close the 3× gap in application-to-interview conversion rate
HYRDD Q1 rate: 1.0% vs. 3–5% industry benchmark. Audit job description quality for top 10 clients, pilot AI-assisted shortlisting.
Owner: Product + Client Success · Q2 Sprint 1
